# Manual high-signal cases for the horizontal leftover pass.
# Isolated singles and isolated adjacent doubles are supposed to PASS (DPC).
# They should be recorded only when they connect to a neighboring cluster.
#
# Legend: '.' good pixel, 'X' dead pixel. Width must be a multiple of 4.
# Pack bits in each group of 4: pos0 pos1 pos2 pos3.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Isolated leftovers — both algorithms should record nothing (DPC).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CASE isolated_single_pos0
NOTE DPC: one leftover single, no neighbor cluster
W 16
H 3
MAP
................
X...............
................
END

CASE isolated_single_pos2
NOTE DPC: one leftover single
W 16
H 3
MAP
................
..X.............
................
END

CASE isolated_adjacent_1100
NOTE DPC: adjacent double 0b1100, skipped in cluster phase on purpose
W 16
H 3
MAP
................
XX..............
................
END

CASE isolated_adjacent_0110
NOTE DPC: adjacent double 0b0110
W 16
H 3
MAP
................
.XX.............
................
END

CASE isolated_adjacent_0011
NOTE DPC: adjacent double 0b0011
W 16
H 3
MAP
................
..XX............
................
END

CASE two_singles_same_channel_across_boundary
NOTE DPC: two singles at distance 2 (pos2 | pos0). Same geometry as intra-group
NOTE 0b1010, but split across packs — each is still a DPC single. Must PASS.
W 16
H 3
MAP
................
..X.X...........
................
END

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Adjacent-double leftover + neighboring cluster — never inspected (sum!=255).
# This is the main hole: the adjacent-double PASS did not consider complex
# patterns formed with a neighboring cluster.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CASE adj_1100_right_of_cluster_1010
NOTE cluster 0b1010 | leftover 0b1100. Boundary: cluster pos2 + adj pos0.
W 16
H 3
MAP
................
X.X.XX..........
................
END
